subject: Billing contact onboarding — portal opt-in with email-copy exception request
messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeco.com
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: New customer set-up — billing contact and PO attached

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick setup call earlier. Attached is our PO (Acme_PO_789.pdf). We have two housekeeping asks before finance can approve the first payment: a) confirm who in Redwood will be the billing/contact on invoices; b) whether invoices will be delivered via your portal only or if we can continue to receive PDF copies by email to procurement@acmeco.com.

Small note on VAT: we may need reverse-charge tagging on EU invoices, but for this contract (US entity) we just need a clear remit and remit-to address on the invoice.

Also attaching a short note from our IT team — our network blocks unknown portals by default, so if you require portal-only delivery we may need a whitelist request (attached).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so AP can move forward with the PO.

Best,
Sarah Jones
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_PO_789.pdf; Acme_Network_Whitelist.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer set-up — billing contact and PO attached

Hi Sarah — thanks for the PO and the heads-up on the whitelist.

Quick answers:
- Billing contact: Kimberly Park (Billing Operations) at billing@redwood.com — we'll put that on the PDF invoice header and in the invoice metadata.
- Delivery options: Redwood's default is portal-first with automatic email copy if the customer opts in; however we can make an exception to send PDF copies automatically to procurement@acmeco.com while you complete whitelist+portal enrollment.

Two asks from our side to make this fully operational:
1) Can procurement confirm the exact remit-to name and bank details they need on the invoice (we'll include your AP reference/PO number).
2) Please confirm whether you need VAT reverse-charge language included for future EU shipments (we can include both tags but want to avoid extra lines on the first US invoice).

I'm copying Marissa from AP onboarding to handle the portal invite and Connor from billing automation to set up the temporary email-copy exception until the portal is reachable from your network. If you prefer, we can mark invoices as "email-copy only" during the pilot and flip to portal-only later.

I'll queue the portal invite once we get the whitelist confirmation.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
billing@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: Redwood_eInvoice_Specs.xlsx

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeco.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer set-up — billing contact and PO attached

Kimberly — thanks, that works. Confirming:
- Remit-to: Acme Corp AP, 1200 Industrial Way, Springfield, IL 62704
- Bank: ACH on Net 30 (please include AP reference: ACME-PO-789)
- VAT: not applicable to this US invoice, but we will need reverse-charge tagging for any EU legal entities in scope later — please include a VAT flag field in your e-invoice metadata so we can toggle it per-entity.

Per IT: attaching the whitelist PDF; they prefer that we keep portal accounts for later once whitelisting is complete. For now please send invoice PDFs to procurement@acmeco.com and cc: ap-team@acmeco.com.

One more ask — to expedite payment, can Redwood include a short note on the invoice body stating "Payment remit: ACH — include PO ACME-PO-789"? That will ensure faster routing on our side.

Thanks again —
Sarah

Attachments: Acme_Network_Whitelist.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New customer set-up — billing contact and PO attached

Sarah — perfect, thank you for the remit details and the whitelist doc. Plan of action from Redwood: 

1) First invoice (covering initial month) will be generated as PDF with header: "Billing contact: Kimberly Park, billing@redwood.com" and a one-line remit note: "Payment remit: ACH — include PO ACME-PO-789" as requested. We will send the PDF to procurement@acmeco.com and ap-team@acmeco.com the moment it's issued.

2) Portal: Marissa will create the portal account and send the invite link. We'll hold off on cutting portal-only delivery until you confirm whitelisting; during that window Connor will configure an "email-copy exception" so every portal invoice also produces an automated PDF copy to the two AP addresses.

3) Metadata: Connor — please ensure the e-invoice payload includes a VAT flag field and an "entityRemit" free-text field so we can toggle reverse-charge language and add the remit instructions per-entity.

4) Compliance: we'll surface the eInvoice spec (attached) and include a short checklist for your AP to sign-off on so we can move to portal-only delivery once whitelisting is validated. If you'd like a DocuSign consent for e-invoice acceptance, we can send that as well.

Sarah, if this meets your needs I will schedule the first invoice to go out tomorrow morning and Marissa will send the portal invite by end of day.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
